purpose: Prevent premature F38 activation and episode promotion; executable checking cannot authenticate independence, licenses, grants, external timestamp services or experimental validity.
frame_requirements: frame digest and independent timestamp receipt binding that digest before window start
explicit adjudicator, selector and investigator identities and external evidence receipts
fixed shared protocol and competitor policy digests
episode_requirements: new issue disclosure during frozen UTC window, no known exposure, external authorship recorded
two behavior-matched source arms frozen before disclosure, identical declared rights/budget/information/oracle
task-specific predictions for both competing predictors frozen before repair or outcome
candidate classes configuration/extension/local/structural considered explicitly; unresolved candidates retained
evidence of independent adjudication before claim promotion
tests: missing required evidence or incomplete frame
scope: No claim of genuine independent future outcome. Validity is metadata consistency only.
